goal: Execute IMP50-01..50 in 0340 dependency order, accepting each only after its parent AUD20 task, approved SPEC, preregistered slice, required evidence and review pass; preserve user changes and use only synthetic/local effects.

criteria.target: Track all 50 unique IMP50 IDs, their priority, parent task, dependencies, gate, current disposition, evidence and next action. Never mark a candidate accepted without evidence tied to its stated acceptance criteria.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare the tracker and per-slice evidence to 0570, 0341 and the current parent-task records; run docs:check and verify IDs/counts and links.

baseline.actual: Planning inventory exists; no IMP50 item is accepted for execution in this round.

criteria.conditions: Dependency order in 0340 governs; priority number does not permit skipping dependencies.
criteria.validity_notes: Planning coverage does not prove product behavior or acceptance.

criteria.target: Before code, confirm parent task state and dependency, an approved SPEC/review for the exact slice, and its registration with owner, files, behavior and acceptance criteria. Keep unresolved or expanded scope waiting for its required human decision.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect the canonical gate records and preregistered task entry before every BUILD diff; fresh review checks that changed files and behavior remain inside the approved boundary.

baseline.actual: AUD20-17/IMP50-40 is WAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL; AUD20-10 is WAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL; AUD20-20 is BLOCKED.

criteria.conditions: Reactivation for local work is not SPEC approval. No BUILD from a draft or inferred decision.
criteria.validity_notes: Human approval remains a distinct gate; it cannot be inferred from elapsed time or tool availability.

criteria.target: For each admitted implementation slice, the stated acceptance behavior passes on its public boundary, required negative cases reject safely, and applicable unit/integration, type, lint and coverage gates pass without deleting or weakening tests.
criteria.evidence_method: Run the exact focused and regression commands required by the approved slice; preserve raw outputs, exit codes and artifact identity; obtain a fresh critic for material slices.

baseline.actual: No product BUILD was authorized or started in this round.

criteria.conditions: Do not run product tests before an admitted slice exists; evidence must match the integrated candidate.
criteria.validity_notes: A passing document check is not evidence of product correctness.

criteria.source: User execution request and repository operating policy
criteria.target: Use synthetic/local-only data and effects; preserve all pre-existing changes; perform no real appointment action, clinical/financial/record action, live integration, real human session, staging, production, commit, push or deploy.
criteria.evidence_method: Review each command, changed-file set, fixtures/configuration and execution receipt; inspect git status and confirm no external endpoint or real dataset was used.

baseline.actual: This round used read-only inspection and documentation planning only; no product or external action occurred.

criteria.conditions: Stop before any action outside the explicitly authorized synthetic/local envelope.
criteria.validity_notes: Worktree already contained extensive changes before this round; compare against recorded baseline rather than a clean-tree assumption.

criteria.source: docs/03_build/0341_plan50_backlog_20260923.md; applicable approved SPEC; repository architecture and accessibility criteria
criteria.target: Refactors preserve public contracts and ownership boundaries with no new dependency cycle. For any visual or interaction change, validate the rendered UI at the specified viewports and keyboard/screen-reader boundary; preserve accessible names, focus, contrast, reflow and handoff behavior required by its approved scope.
criteria.evidence_method: Run architecture/contract tests and inspect the actual rendered artifact in specified viewport and interaction scenarios; attach screenshots only when permitted by the applicable consent and privacy rules.

baseline.actual: No admitted architecture or UI slice was built in this round.

criteria.conditions: Apply only to slices that touch the relevant architecture or UI surface; no new harness/session without its own SPEC gate.
criteria.license_notes: Internal project material; generated screenshots require applicable consent.
criteria.validity_notes: For non-UI slices the visual portion is not applicable; accessibility is never inferred from automated checks alone where a human gate is specified.

criteria.target: For applicable package/finalization slices, the manifest, tests, image/SBOM/scans, mutation/critic results and receipts identify one exact candidate; any later applicable write invalidates stale evidence and requires the specified reseal.
criteria.evidence_method: Recompute the source/candidate digest independently and compare all required receipts after the last write; exercise stale/mixed-candidate negatives.

baseline.actual: No final candidate was frozen or sealed in this round.

criteria.conditions: Applicable to candidate/release work only; documentation evidence cannot stand in for artifact receipts.
criteria.validity_notes: The current worktree is dirty and has no final candidate hash for this Plan50 goal.

criteria.target: Applicable local composition/recovery gates pass on disposable synthetic resources. External provider/channel/identity/RAG, restore, pilot, accessibility session and sign-off are accepted only with their own authorized evidence; if outside the user's current limits, preserve the item as blocked/waiting.
criteria.evidence_method: Use the exact disposable runtime/human-session procedures when separately authorized; verify required gates and zero required skips; record blocked gates without substituting fixtures for real-world acceptance.

baseline.actual: AUD20-19 human session is not authorized; external/human gates and AUD20-20 dependencies remain outstanding.

criteria.conditions: No real data, live service, human session or external side effect may be initiated under the current request.
criteria.validity_notes: A blocked gate is an honest non-pass and may prevent full Plan50 completion.

criteria.source: Gauntlet criteria PLAN50-P0 through PLAN50-P6 and user constraints
criteria.target: Report IMP50 done/in progress/blocked with task IDs, evidence and candidate identity. Claim full Plan50 completion only when every required IMP50 acceptance criterion passes on current evidence and all required reviews pass. Keep staging and production NO_GO; no release is implied.
criteria.evidence_method: Reconcile final tracker with all per-item evidence and parent-task states; independent final critic inspects the integrated tree and evidence freshness.
